title: Fully delimited template expressions as password values
summary: password: "{{ vault_db_password }}" in double-quoted, single-quoted and JSON carriers: a Jinja-style expression that opens and closes its delimiters and names a variable.
rationale: A template expression is a reference to a secret that lives elsewhere. Flagging it, or flagging only the text inside the braces, breaks every Ansible or Helm file written correctly.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. A complete template expression holds no secret bytes; the value is the variable's name.
